briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate multi-agent race as US tightens chip controls

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 11 new models this month amid $11.9B in quarterly funding. US export controls and Chinese model gains intensify competition while safety gaps widen.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced multi-agent orchestration; DeepSeek R2 matched performance at lower cost; Anthropic and Google DeepMind announced incremental Claude 4 and Gemini 3 updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 1.2M Blackwell GPUs; Microsoft and Google announced new 100k-GPU clusters in Texas and Arizona; TSMC 2nm yields improved 15%.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level defenses such as DialectForge become mandatory for all frontier multi-agent deployments before 2028?
